changes.after: Content edit to the existing card w24.5. The card said 'כתבו על החתך' but showed no section diagram. It now carries the branch's version: the title 'מסמנים נתונים על חתך צירי'; a labelled axial-section SVG ('בסיס החתך = ?' and 'גובה = ?'); the text 'רדיוס בסיס החרוט הוא 6 ס״מ וגובהו 8 ס״מ. כתבו ליד השרטוט:'; and two answer lines, 'בסיס החתך הצירי = ___ ס״מ' and 'גובה המשולש = ___ ס״מ'. Everything is in harut markup: data-q="w24.5" is kept (workbook.json already lists it), with .q-bullet and harut's cols-2 / figure-box / blank bw-6. I made two small figure fixes from the branch. (1) The branch triangle was 210 wide by 112 high (1.875:1), while the real ratio of 2r to h is 12:8 (1.5:1). I set the base to 66..234, so the figure is now to scale (RULES §8, a scale that does not mislead). (2) The branch label 'גובה = ?' used text-anchor=end, which inherits RTL, so in the render it lay on the dashed height line. I moved it to x=122, y=112 with text-anchor=middle, inside the triangle and clear of the line and edges. To keep the page on one A4 sheet I changed only page-scoped CSS in page-5's <head>: main[data-layout="w24"] .draw-box height goes from 270px to 180px (the w24.4 drawing box, still about 4.8 cm), and there are 2 new rules scoped to main[data-layout="w24"] [data-q="w24.5"] (.cols-2 align-items:center; .figure-medium max-height:140px). CRLF line endings are preserved and the diff is 2 hunks.
changes.reason: No new page. The edit is in place in page 5 (w24), stage 'רדיוס, גובה, יוצר וחתך צירי', subtopic 'חתך צירי', level 2. It stays after w20 (page 4: radius, height and slant height with r=6, h=8, l=10) and before w25 (page 6: area of the axial section). The prerequisites are w24.1, where the axial section of a right cone is an isosceles triangle, and w24.2, where the section base is the diameter, 2r. Both come before w24.5 on the same page, so its order is unchanged.
